Our client is a leading security and life safety specialist dedicated to protecting commercial and residential properties across the region. In this technical role, you will analyze site survey data, floor plans, and visual media to design accurate, compliant system solutions. Your precision in estimating equipment and producing sharp commercial quotes will directly fuel the company's growth and project success.

• Specify Equipment: Assess existing fire and security infrastructure to determine required systems, components, and hardware.

• Calculate Quantities: Estimate material requirements, device counts, cable runs, and labor needs based on remote survey data.

• Manage Costs: Source supplier pricing for specialized hardware to keep component costs competitive.

Requirements

• Industry Experience: Proven background in estimating, desktop surveying, or system design within Fire & Security.

• Technical Knowledge: Familiarity with fire alarms, intruder alarms, IP CCTV, and access control platforms.

• Plan Literacy: Ability to read and extract measurements from scale floor plans and schematic drawings.

title: Account Executive, Enterprise, Asset Management
description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth - personal, professional, and financial - is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Harvey is the AI platform trusted by the world's leading law firms and corporate legal teams, and one of the fastest-growing companies in AI. Now we're bringing that to asset management - and this role owns it. We're building the team that will define how the world's leading asset managers, private equity firms, and institutional funds adopt AI. This is a ground-floor opportunity to own a new vertical - we're still proving out this motion, which means the person who joins will help write the playbook.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Develop and manage a named account list across asset management - private equity, venture, private credit, hedge funds, real assets, and institutional allocators (LPs) - and own the full sales cycle from prospecting through contracting and expansion.

- Build and manage senior relationships across each firm's legal, compliance, and investment teams - typically anchored by a GC, CLO, or CCO - expanding into portfolio-company counsel over time. Understand how decisions get made in these organizations and navigate accordingly.

- Lead complex, multi-threaded deals with stakeholders ranging from managing directors and general partners to day-to-day legal and compliance users - translating Harvey's AI capabilities into language that resonates with financial buyers.

- Work closely with product and engineering to stay current on Harvey's capabilities and shape solutions around how asset managers actually work - contract review, due diligence, portfolio company support, regulatory workflows.

- Conduct tailored demos and presentations that connect Harvey's product directly to the workflows and pain points specific to financial services buyers.

- Document what works. This team is building the asset management playbook from scratch, and your learnings will directly shape how we scale the motion.

WHAT YOU HAVE

- Experience selling complex software or professional services into financial services (ideally asset management, private equity, or institutional funds). You understand how these firms are structured and how buying decisions get made.

- Proven ability to run a global or named account relationship - you've been the person a firm calls, not just the person who closes a deal and moves on. Ideally you've navigated a fund relationship or portfolio company motion.

- Background in enterprise software sales, management consulting, or a combination - we're intentionally mixing profiles on this team. If you've unlocked a major financial services account or come from a firm that advises these organizations, we want to talk to you.

- Comfortable operating in a motion that's still being defined. You're a builder who can prospect independently, iterate on messaging, and contribute to the team's collective learning.

title: Vice President of Account Management
description:
About MedReview
MedReview is a leading provider of payment integrity solutions that help national and regional health plans promote population health, ensure payment accuracy, reduce administrative waste, improve provider relationships, and optimize financial performance. For more than four decades, MedReview has partnered with health plans, third-party administrators, and other healthcare organizations to deliver technology-enabled solutions that identify savings opportunities, drive operational efficiency, and improve healthcare outcomes. The Opportunity
We are seeking an experienced Vice President of Account Management to build and lead MedReview’s Account Management function. This leader will be responsible for the day-to-day management of the Account Management team, direct oversight of MedReview’s most strategic client relationships, and development of account strategies that improve retention, client satisfaction, and revenue growth. The Vice President will create a consistent, consultative approach to account management and serve as the primary escalation point between clients and MedReview.
Key Responsibilities:
Account Management Leadership

• Build and lead a high-performing Account Management team with clear roles, coverage models, service standards, and performance expectations.

• Develop and implement consistent account management processes, tools, meeting cadences, and documentation standards.

• Coach Account Managers on strategic relationship management, executive communication, issue resolution, and commercial growth.

• Establish portfolio-level visibility into client health, retention risk, growth opportunities, and profitability.

• Promote accountability for timely follow-up, accurate communication, and coordinated client support.

Strategic Client Relationship Management

• Serve as the senior relationship leader for MedReview’s largest and most strategic accounts, including key national health plan relationships.

• Build trusted relationships with client executives, operational leaders, and key decision-makers.

• Develop and execute client strategies that support retention, satisfaction, and long-term growth.

• Lead internal portfolio reviews and ensure Account Managers deliver effective client-facing business reviews.

• Act as the first senior escalation point for client issues, service concerns, and relationship risks.

Retention and Account Growth

• Lead account planning to identify cross-sell, upsell, and new-solution opportunities within existing clients.

• Partner with Business Development, Product, Operations, and senior leaders to evaluate and prioritize expansion opportunities.

• Support new-client acquisition by contributing client insight, solution positioning, and relationship continuity during the sales process.

• Develop retention plans for at-risk accounts and proactively address competitive threats.

• Develop and track key metrics to assess overall account health, including growth, retention, client satisfaction, profitability, and opportunity conversion.

• Develop and track performance metrics and KPIs to measure the effectiveness and success of the Account Management team.

• Own adherence to client SLAs, ensuring service commitments and performance standards are consistently met.

Client Delivery and Commercial Coordination

• Partner closely with Operations to support delivery excellence and positive client outcomes.

• Negotiate service level agreements in partnership with appropriate internal leaders and ensure Account Managers monitor performance.

• Coordinate resolution of claims aging, recovery execution, payment, and other issues that may affect client value or MedReview revenue.

• Ensure the Account Management team serves as the central point of coordination between clients and MedReview.

• Support effective implementation and transition of new clients, products, and services.

Voice of the Customer

• Bring client feedback, market intelligence, and emerging need

title: Pharmacy Technician (Seasonal)
description:
Who We Are:
SmithRx is a rapidly growing, venture-backed Health-Tech company. Our mission is to disrupt the expensive and inefficient Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) sector by building a next-generation drug acquisition platform driven by cutting edge technology, innovative cost saving tools, and best-in-class customer service. With hundreds of thousands of members onboarded since 2016, SmithRx has a solution that is resonating with clients all across the country.
We pride ourselves for our mission-driven and collaborative culture that inspires our employees to do their best work. We believe that the U.S healthcare system is in need of transformation, and we come to work each day dedicated to making that change a reality. At our core, we are guided by our company values:

•
Integrity: Our purpose guides our actions and gives us confidence in the path ahead. With unwavering honesty and dependability, we embrace the pressure of challenging the old and exemplify ethical leadership to create the new.

•
Courage: We face continuous challenges with grit and resilience. We embrace the discomfort of the unknown by balancing autonomy with empathy, and ownership with vulnerability. We boldly challenge the status quo to keep moving forward-always.

•
Together: The success of SmithRx reflects the strength of our partnerships and the commitment of our team. Our shared values bind us together and make us one. When one falls, we all fall; when one rises, we all rise.

Job Summary:
This is a 6 month contract position where you will assist members, providers, pharmacies, and the internal SmithRx teams to navigate complexities of prescriptions to guide timely coverage of clinically appropriate, cost effective medication therapy in accordance with plan benefit design and clinical criteria for coverage. This may involve coordination of clinical review cases, checking coverage and plan rules, verification of submitted information, pharmacy and provider outreach, review of prior authorization requests within established protocols, and assisting to triage and troubleshoot questions and escalations. At SmithRx , we design customized benefit plans for our customers and you are at the forefront of helping navigate and execute drug access.
What you will do:

• Verify eligibility and drug coverage under the plan benefit design to determine appropriate claims processing

• Responsible for triaging the process of clinical review for prior authorization requests at different levels as per established protocols

• Review prior authorization and similar requests under protocol using prior authorization criteria, claims history and plan benefit rules, including prescriber/pharmacy outreach to verify and gather complete required information

• Organize and prioritize multiple requests internally and externally to ensure timely prior authorization case management.

• Build and adjust authorizations under protocol within the claim adjudication system

• Use pharmacy technician experience to navigate drug products, formulations, and perform basic calculations to check and monitor accurate claims adjudication.

• Ability to critically assess and synthesize multiple workflows together in order to make a sound clinical decision

• Work across teams to coordinate outreach, address questions/escalations, and help guide processes and protocols for timely and appropriate medication coverage.

• Evaluate member clinical situation against medication policies and make a determination to approve or triage to Pharmacist for denial

• Critically assess when medications need to be sent for internal or external review based on synthesizing multiple protocols together

• Reach out to select external stakeholders for approval on drugs with dollar limits

What you will bring to SmithRx :

• High School diploma or GED or equivalent work experience

• Active Pharmacy Technician license required

• 2-4 years of experience as a Pharmacy Technician

• Experience in prior authorization

title: Head of Marketing, EMEA

ABOUT EXA

We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.

Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders & dropouts alike.

We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

We are looking for a Head of Marketing, EMEA based in London to lead Exa's marketing across Europe.

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is Exa's first senior marketing leader outside the United States. You will set the marketing strategy for Europe and run it as a commercial function, tied to the region's pipeline number. EMEA is many markets with different buyers, languages, and routes to market. Deciding which ones matter first, and how Exa wins in each, is the core of the job.

Sales coverage is coming online across the UK and EU. You will be the marketing counterpart: deciding where to invest, which motions to run in which markets, and how a fast-moving American AI infrastructure company earns credibility with buyers in London, Berlin, Zurich, and Amsterdam.

This is a player-coach role. You will write the regional plan and then help execute it yourself, from shaping a campaign and adapting the message to hosting an executive dinner and sitting in pipeline reviews with Sales. You start as a team of one, with meaningful budget for field events, conferences, and developer events. We expect your first hire, an early-career field events marketer, to join within months, with more headcount as growth justifies.

Exa's buyers are technical, and much of our growth starts with developers who sign up and build before anyone talks to Sales. The right person understands both product-led growth with developers and account-based programs for enterprise buyers. You will work closely with Sales, Product, and Marketing to keep all of it pointed at the same priorities.

This is an AI-first role at an AI-first company. Account research, localization, campaign analysis, and reporting should be workflows you build, since one person covering a dozen markets only works if the work is automated.

This role is based in-person in London, with regular travel across EMEA and periodic trips to our San Francisco HQ.

 

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 

EMEA MARKETING STRATEGY

Own the regional marketing plan. Translate Exa's global priorities into a plan for EMEA, prioritize markets by opportunity and sales coverage, and decide where to invest across markets and programs. Own the EMEA marketing budget, which centers on field events, conferences, developer events, and selective local sponsorships (including developer creators and communities). Success is measured by revenue growth.

 

GO-TO-MARKET BY MARKET

Build a go-to-market approach for priority markets across the UK, EU, Middle East and Africa. The right motion differs by market (direct, partner-led, or channel-based), and some markets should wait until product-led signal justifies the spend.

Own EMEA pipeline targets. Build the programs that create qualified opportunities and move them through the cycle: account-based campaigns, executive dinners, a small number of high-value trade shows, reactivation of any stalled pipeline, and webinars or localized content. Use pipeline and conversion data to shift investment toward what works. Success is measured by pipeline and by cost per opportunity.

 

SALES PARTNERSHIP

Supply Chain Systems Support Analyst

Anduril Industries

 

About the Team

Anduril's Supply Chain organization is building the systems infrastructure to scale procurement, planning, and logistics across a rapidly growing defense technology portfolio. Within this organization, the Digital Supply Chain function is responsible for optimizing supply chain operations through implementation, management, and continuous improvement of the digital platforms that power sourcing, inventory, fulfillment, and supplier management. You will own the intake, evaluation, debug, escalation, communications, and tracking of reported incidents across the platforms that support procurement, purchasing, planning, inventory, and logistics operations. The user base supported by this role includes supply chain analysts, procurement specialists, buyers, planners, and program managers. Support case duration and technical complexity will range widely.

Beyond reactive support, you will be embedded in supply chain operations, working cross-functionally with Procurement, Purchasing, Planning, Program Management, IT, Engineering, Business Systems, and other stakeholders to solve complex systems problems that span multiple teams and don't fall neatly into any single domain. You bring structure to ambiguity, think in systems, and drive solutions where others see only complexity.

Triage, Troubleshooting & Incident Resolution

• Serve as the critical bridge between supply chain operations and digital supply chain systems (ERP, PR apps) identifying and resolving software issues that impact supply chain efficiency.

• Monitor intake of reported software problems across multiple supply chain platforms and triage based on urgency, impact, and scope.

• Conduct root cause analysis by observing actual supply chain processes and how they interact with digital systems to identify disconnects between software functionality and operational needs.

• Escalate to engineering support when required and provide clear operational context to software development teams about supply chain realities and downstream impacts.

• Develop workarounds and best practices that accommodate both system limitations and supply chain requirements, minimizing disruption to ongoing operations.

• Proactively identify potential unreported problems by regularly analyzing system data patterns, monitoring supply chain KPIs, and reviewing process adherence across platforms.

Cross-Functional Problem Solving & Systems Thinking

• Step into high-priority problems that span multiple teams and systems, bringing structure to ambiguity and driving resolution without waiting for clear ownership or prescribed solutions.

• Project manage across large, cross-functional groups of stakeholders-leading meetings, managing communications, and driving alignment toward solutions amid challenging deadlines and moving milestones.

You won't be supporting the sale from the sidelines. You'll be  driving it  - translating client challenges into compelling solutions, guiding pursuit teams through complex opportunities, and serving as a trusted advisor clients actually want at the table.
Come join us
There is one in every group - the person who dreams big and has the motivation to bring their ideas to life, even as others might roll their eyes and prefer to play it safe. Are you that person?
Are you the one who isn’t afraid to break the mold and who gets passionate about the power of digital to transform organizations and ways of working? Lead from the front line of sales.  Partner directly with clients and account leaders to scope, shape, and win high-value opportunities - bringing clarity, creativity, and momentum to every pursuit.

•
Be the connective tissue of the deal.  Orchestrate the people, assets, and decisions that move a pursuit forward, ensuring pursuit teams have exactly what they need, exactly when they need it.

Shape how we sell.  Design the playbooks, differentiators, and cross-sell motions that give our sellers an edge - and continuously raise the bar on how Avanade competes and wins.

•
Champion selling excellence.  Embed best-in-class pursuit discipline (DEEPR) and enablement tools so every team operates at the top of its game.

•
Spot the next opportunity first.  Anticipate shifting client and market needs and proactively reshape how we engage - staying one step ahead of expectations.

About you
Characteristics that can spell success for this role:

• You love to work collaboratively with energy, drive and dedication to overcome obstacles to achieve your goals.

• You take ownership and encourage others to make a positive impact.

Enjoy your career

A great place to work

description:
JOB SUMMARY

Calero , the leading technology expense management solution for complex enterprises, is looking for a full-time, detail-oriented Managed Bill Pay Analyst. The primary responsibility of the Managed Bill Pay Analyst is to ensure the timely and accurate payment of accounts on behalf of Calero customers.

• Preferred hours: 9-5pm EST (with some flexibility)

Responsibilities :

• Work within a team environment to manage payments on behalf of all assigned Calero customers. This may include both directly processing payments and/or monitoring payments sent to a 3 rd party processor.

• Research issues with payments when they occur, ensuring corrective action where necessary, utilizing a variety of payment methods and interfaces.

• Review all payment methods assigned to customer profiles for the possibility of upgrading to credit card payments once per month.

• Assist when needed in reviewing incoming funding for all assigned customers and allocate funding to related invoices pending processing in Calero ’s payment system. Use of intermediary accounting skills, including tools like MS Excel will be required.

• Work in concert with all invoice lifecycle touchpoints and Managed Bill Pay Team to ensure SLA metrics are achieved for all assigned Calero Bill Pay customers.

• Complete weekly or monthly assignments in order of priority in cooperation with Senior Management within Managed Bill Pay, or Service Operations Manager and other Business Unit leadership.

• Manage daily payment activity to meet all KPI requirements assigned by direct manager.

• Ensure all payments are executed correctly based on the customer’s approved amounts.

• Other projects and duties as assigned.

Education :

• Associate degree in Finance, Business, Mathematics or IT preferred

• High School Diploma or GED equivalent required

• A combination of education and experience will be considered

Experience and Training:

• 1-3 years’ experience in Accounting or Finance is preferred

• Prior experience working in a fast-paced environment is required

Technical Knowledge :

• (Required) Proficient with MS Office; advanced Excel (ability to do V-look up’s, pivot tables etc.)

• Analytical aptitude and logical reasoning

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Self-starter, ability to work independently

• Ability to handle confidential information in a professional manner

• Focused and results-oriented

Calero is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, protected veteran status, or status as a qualified individual with a disability.

The starting hourly wage for this role is $19.50-$22.00/hr. It is important to Calero that potential candidates for this position understand that compensation depends on numerous factors including the geographic location where the role will be performed, skills required, experience, complexity, travel, and market rate. Calero aims to reward performance and attract top talent with competitive, fair pay and benefits. Please note that the top of the salary range represents exceptional, and/or senior-level positions, that meets all required qualifications. Actual offers take candidate’s knowledge, skills, abilities, and experience into account. Base Pay is just one component of the total compensation package for employees. Other rewards vary by position and location.

description:
Role : Quality Associate
Location : Work From Home

About Astro Lokal

Astro Lokal connects users with astrologers through calls, chats, and video consultations. We aim to deliver a reliable, consistent, and high-quality customer experience by maintaining service standards and ensuring astrologers and customer-facing teams adhere to defined quality guidelines.

Role Overview:

The Quality Associate will be responsible for maintaining and improving service quality across Astro Lokal 's customer-facing operations. The role involves auditing calls, chats, and video sessions, identifying performance gaps, delivering training interventions, and working closely with Operations to improve customer experience and service delivery.

Key Responsibilities :

1. Quality Assurance

• Conduct regular quality audits of astrologer calls, chats, and video sessions, along with other customer interactions as required.

• Evaluate interactions against defined quality parameters, including greetings, active listening, communication skills, accuracy, customer handling, and compliance with SOPs.

• Identify process deviations, knowledge gaps, and recurring customer experience issues.

• Provide constructive feedback and coaching recommendations to improve performance.

• Maintain quality scorecards, audit records, and performance trend reports.

• Share quality insights and improvement recommendations with Operations and Team Leads.

2. Training & Development

• Manage the end-to-end training lifecycle, including onboarding, refresher training, and training for new processes.

• Develop and maintain training materials, SOPs, learning modules, and knowledge documentation.

• Conduct classroom and virtual training sessions for new and existing team members.

• Design assessments and certification frameworks to evaluate knowledge retention and operational readiness.

• Collaborate with Operations and Quality teams to deliver targeted training interventions for low-performing individuals.

• Update training content based on quality findings, process changes, and business requirements.

3. Performance Improvement

• Track training effectiveness through quality scores, assessment results, and operational performance metrics.

• Analyze quality trends to identify recurring issues and opportunities for improvement.

• Partner with Operations and Team Leads to address skill gaps and improve service delivery.

• Recommend corrective actions and process improvements to enhance customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.

• Monitor the impact of training and coaching interventions on quality and performance benchmarks

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in any discipline.

• 3+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, Training, Learning & Development, or Customer Experience within a customer support, contact centre, or BPO environment.

• Hands-on experience in quality audits, call/chat monitoring, agent coaching, and training delivery.

• Strong understanding of QA frameworks, customer service metrics, SOP compliance, and coaching methodologies.

• Fluency in Kannada and English , including reading, writing, and speaking.

• Strong communication, presentation, facilitation, and analytical skills.

• Proficiency in Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Google Workspace.

• Experience creating training content, assessments, and certification programs is preferred.

• Familiarity with speech-to-text tools, CRM systems, and quality monitoring platforms is an advantage.

title: Oracle DBA/Developer
description:
Imagineeer is a fast-growing SBA 8(a) Small Disadvantaged Business headquartered in Arlington, VA, delivering federal AI modernization across health, defense, homeland security, and transportation. We design, test, and deploy secure, AI-ready systems that move agencies from pilots to production without breaking governance, compliance, or mission continuity. Our Mission Studio model creates shared environments where policy, data, security, and operations come together. We are capability-driven and competitive by design, not program-dependent. Our leadership has operated inside the federal systems we now transform, bringing institutional knowledge that accelerates delivery and reduces risk. If real delivery motivates you more than slides, and you want your work to compound across programs and agencies, Imagineeer is growing and we are building the team to match.

About the role

Imagineeer is seeking an experienced Oracle DBA/Developer to join our team supporting the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) Human Resources Information Technology (HRIT) contract. In this role, you will help modernize how HHS receives, processes, and uses critical HR and payroll data by consolidating and standardizing key federal data file exchanges, building reliable Oracle-based intake and processing workflows, and analyzing a large enterprise HR data environment to document how its tables, reports, and downstream data exchanges are used across the Department. This is a hands-on technical role for someone who enjoys bringing structure and clarity to complex data systems and who can work effectively with both technical teams and government stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:

• Support consolidation of CIDB files, including obtaining the CIDB Full file from Office of Personnel Management (OPM) and generating the CIDB Abbreviated file internally to eliminate reliance on externally supplied abbreviated extracts.

• Standardize the intake, format, and processing of the Admin (SAC Codes) file received from OPM.

• Standardize the intake, format, and processing of the Paytran file, including developing a file format specification to share with OPM and establishing receipt of the file from OPM

• Analyze the technical usage of the Enterprise Human Capital Management (EHCM) data dump, including reviewing 100+ data tables to determine purpose and usage, identifying derived files, associated reports, and data exchanges with HHS Operating Divisions (OPDIVs) that rely on the data dump.

• Design, develop, and maintain PL/SQL packages, procedures, and ETL processes to ingest, validate, and transform incoming data files.

• Perform Oracle database administration tasks, including performance tuning, schema management, backup and recovery, and security configuration.

• Produce technical documentation, including data dictionaries, data lineage, file format specifications, and standard operating procedures.

Qualifications and Skills:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Information Technology, or a related field.

• 6+ years of experience as an Oracle DBA and/or Oracle Developer

• Advanced proficiency in SQL and PL/SQL, including stored procedures, complex queries, and performance tuning

• Experience building ETL processes for flat-file ingestion (fixed-width and delimited) using SQL*Loader, external tables, or equivalent tools

• Experience developing file format specifications or interface control documents for external data exchanges

• Experience standardizing and consolidating data file processes

• Experience working with OPM file exchanges

• Ability to analyze large, complex data sets to determine purpose, usage, and downstream dependencies

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

Desired Skills and Competencies:

• Familiarity with Oracle HCM / EHCM data structures

• Experience with federal HR and payroll data, such as EHRI, personnel and payroll transaction data, or the OPM Guide to Data Standards

We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

• Partner with Product, Engineering, IT, Deal Desk, and Finance to ensure pricing guidance, cost inputs, product telemetry, and related data are properly captured, maintained, and reflected in business systems

Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role
We are a software engineering team applying open-source data technologies to some of the world's hardest and most important problems. Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

- Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant - Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.

YOUR IMPACT

In this role you will be building the automated security pipelines and AI-specific guardrails that protect our frontier models and research data, which is critical for maintaining the integrity of our materials discovery engine and the trust of our global partners.

- Lead incident response efforts by monitoring production logs for anomalies and collaborating with AI Researchers to deploy rapid fixes.

- Empower the engineering team to own security by providing tools for local IDE security scanning and pre-commit hooks.

- Act as a security educator, cultivating a culture of shared responsibility across the AI, chemistry, and engineering teams.

- Partner with researchers, chemists, and engineers to translate security requirements into practical workflows that support rather than slow down scientific work.

MUST HAVE SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:

- You are motivated by the mission of using AI for planetary-scale impact and understand the high stakes of securing "deep tech" intellectual property.

- 3+ years of experience in a DevSecOps, Cloud Security, or Site Reliability Engineering role, preferably within a fast-paced startup or AI-centric company.

- Proven experience building and securing CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins).

- Strong proficiency

title: Social Media Community Coordinator (12 month FTC)
description:
Ready to revolutionize healthcare, making it faster and more accessible than ever before? 

How we started:

Founded in 2013 by Dwayne D’Souza, HeliosX   was built on a simple but powerful idea: healthcare should be easier to access, faster to receive, and centred around the individual. From day one, we’ve grown without external funding; scaling profitably through technology, disciplined execution, and deep medical expertise. What started as a challenger idea has become one of the most significant healthcare platforms operating globally today.

Where we are now:

We’ve earned the trust of millions of people worldwide through category-leading products and well-known brands, including MedExpress, Dermatica, ZipHealth, RocketRX, and Levity. A key driver of our success is vertical integration; we operate our own manufacturing and proprietary products, led by in-house medical teams, researchers, and pharmacists at the top of their fields.

In 2025, HeliosX treated more than 1.7 million patients globally and reached £781m in revenue, representing +337% year-on-year growth and cementing our position as the clear market leader in the UK. That growth translates into real-world outcomes: our weight-loss treatments helped patients lose 8.5 million kilograms of excess weight in 2025 alone, contributing to an estimated 1,300 fewer cardiac events. This is growth with measurable, life-changing impact at scale.

Today, we operate across four international markets, with successful launches in Germany and Canada and continued expansion in the US. We were also recently recognised in the Sunday Times Top 100 fastest-growing tech companies, further validation of both our momentum and our ambition.

Where we’re going:

2026 is another significant year for HeliosX. Our ambition is to surpass £1.1bn in revenue, continue expanding thoughtfully into new international markets and broaden our condition and treatment portfolio. As we scale, we're focused on building the technology, operational excellence and clinical capabilities that will support sustainable long-term growth. Joining HeliosX now means helping shape the systems, teams and products that will define the next chapter of digital healthcare. You'll be solving complex problems at pace, working alongside exceptional people and building products that genuinely improve lives at scale.

There’s never been a more exciting time to join HeliosX. Come be a part of making our dream of easier and faster healthcare a reality!

The Role:

We are looking for a Social Media Community Coordinator to look after our customers across social media. The role focuses on community management for MedExpress, with support for ZipHealth and RocketRx, and supports our organic social objective of adding value for customers by making sure they get a fast, helpful response to their queries.

Reporting directly to Georgie Taylor in the Brand team, you will work closely with our customer care teams in the UK, Canada and US, and with our Insights team, to make sure customer needs and pain points are reflected in the content we create.

This is a 12 month fixed term contract on a hybrid basis, based in our London office.

What You'll Do:

• Moderate and respond to customer care related messages and comments on our brand social channels, mainly Facebook and Instagram, using our community management tool. MedExpress is the priority, followed by ZipHealth and RocketRx.

• Help us keep response times under 24 hours and maintain a 100% response rate to customer queries on social media.

• Triage customer queries that need a customer care agent and pass them to the customer care team using our agreed processes, so that unhappy customers are looked after quickly.

• Run daily social listening in Brand24, flagging issues to the right stakeholders inside and outside the social team, and engaging with brand mentions that are not tagged.

• Use social listening insights to support content planning and highlight content opp

title: Staff Frontend Engineer, Consumer Alliance
description:
At HelloFresh, our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. As a global digital-native FMCG company and the world's leading mealkit provider, we are transforming the traditional food supply chain through a data-driven, on-demand model that enables scalable and more sustainable food delivery. The HelloFresh Group includes eight brands serving customers across multiple meal occasions, including HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, and Chefs Plate, as well as ready-to-eat meals from Factor and YouFoodz, meat and seafood subscriptions through Good Chop, and pet nutrition with The Pets Table. Through technology, data, and culinary innovation, we deliver personalized food experiences to millions of households worldwide. 

About the Role: What's in the Box

At HelloFresh, Staff Frontend Engineers own customer problems from discovery to delivery, not just tickets. As a Staff Frontend Engineer, you will anchor our customer-facing surfaces. You will turn ambiguous customer challenges into strong technical points of view, validate them with data and customer insights, and use AI tooling to ship high-impact features faster. Your technical depth is your anchor, not your boundary. You will collaborate across disciplines, raise the architectural bar, and keep our frontend platforms fast and reliable for millions of households worldwide.

What You’ll Do: The Recipe

• Lead the customer-facing surfaces, driving measurable improvements in conversion, activation, and retention.

• Own customer problems end to end: frame the problem, form a technical point of view, validate it with data and customer insight, and ship it.

• Work full-stack when the user problem demands it, moving across boundaries to deliver cohesive solutions.

• Operate what you build: instrument, monitor, and improve frontend performance, reliability, and observability in production.

• Set the architecture and technical direction for the frontend platform, and make the tradeoffs between user impact and engineering complexity explicit.

• Partner with product management, design, and analytics to test hypotheses early, prototype quickly, and keep a fast, continuous shipping cadence.

• Champion AI developer workflows (for example Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot), set practical standards for agentic coding, and help teams make AI an everyday productivity multiplier.

• Mentor and grow frontend engineers across squads, and establish best practices for code quality, reusable design components, and scalable frontend systems.

What You’ll Bring: The Ingredients

• Strong fluency in React Native and familiarity with the full app release cycle, test automation, on device performance, and platform UX conventions.

• Strong fluency in React, TypeScript, with a solid foundation in web performance and distributed frontend architectures. You have the design taste to ship coherent user experiences without a designer in the loop for early iterations.

• A strong product mindset. You are opinionated about what should be built and why, and you back that opinion with data and user evidence.

• Daily, hands-on use of AI coding tools and agents. You understand how contextual prompting, boundaries, and validation shape code quality, and you set guardrails for AI-generated work.

• A bias to ship and full ownership. You push projects across the finish line and sweat the final twenty percent.

• Clear, data-grounded decisions. You weigh customer empathy against engineering complexity through rigorous tradeoff analysis.

What we offer: The Toppings

• Global collaboration at scale: Collaborate with experienced engineers and product partners across HelloTech’s international teams, in a culture of active knowledge sharing.

• Technology with real-world impact: Build and operate modern systems at a global scale, supporting 6+ million customers and complex supply chain operations.

Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.   The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems. We also build the communication mechanisms that connect devices to each other and to the host. Security runs through all of it. Trusted Access helps eligible customers access and use advanced AI capabilities with appropriate safeguards. Within User Safety & Risk Operations, we connect customer onboarding, eligibility review, access provisioning, and support into a service customers can navigate with confidence.

We work with Product, Engineering, technical support, regional operations, and customer-facing teams to resolve difficult access problems and improve the systems behind them. Our work combines sound judgment on individual cases with better products, clearer guidance, and automation that reduces unnecessary friction.

About the role

We’re looking for a senior operations leader to own the Trusted Access operating strategy and lead a team of risk-operations specialists. You will set priorities across programs, build a reliable customer access service, and hire, manage, and develop your direct reports.

This role combines program ownership with formal people management. You will establish shared commitments with technical support and regional escalation leaders, who manage their own teams, and bring those groups together around customer outcomes. Success means customers reach the right access outcome with clear communication, teams make consistent decisions, and the service scales with less avoidable escalation and manual work.

- Hire, coach, and develop your team. Set expectations, delegate meaningful ownership, give direct feedback, address performance gaps, and build the capabilities needed as programs grow.

- Prepare new programs and customer channels for launch and scale. Align support responsibilities, review standards, customer guidance, and technical dependencies; make readiness gaps and tradeoffs clear to leadership.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have built and run complex customer support, onboarding, access, risk, or service operations, with measurable improvements beyond handling more volume.

- Have led work across teams you do not manage, resolving ownership gaps and negotiating commitments that hold up in execution.

Unit4 serves a global community of professional services organizations - management consultancies, engineering and architectural practices, IT services firms, audit and advisory, and legal services. These businesses run on people: utilization, engagement profitability, and project delivery define how they win or lose. As Product Director for Professional Services, you own the vertical product vision, strategy, and roadmap that makes Unit4 the ERP of choice for mid-market PSOs.
This is not a generalist PM role with an industry overlay. You will have dedicated engineering capacity to build genuine vertical depth in the platform - industry-specific capabilities that horizontal product teams cannot and will not build. You will work in close partnership with horizontal PMs across Financials, HR, Projects, and Procurement to ensure the full platform delivers for PSOs end-to-end. You own the backlog, the outcomes, the roadmap, and the commercial case for why your vertical wins.
AI is actively reshaping how professional services firms operate. The automation of billable work, the compression of traditional T&M models, and the shift toward outcome- and subscription-based pricing are rewriting the economics of the sector. The right candidate understands where these firms are in that journey and what it means for the software they need. You have built enterprise software for PSOs, you know what the best solutions in this space do well and where they fall short, and you can translate an industry in transition into a product roadmap that stays ahead of it.
What You'll Do

• Own the Professional Services product vision, strategy, and multi-horizon roadmap; align it with Unit4 's platform strategy and commercial growth targets.

• Own feature outcomes, not just delivery - define clear adoption, usage, and customer impact goals for every capability you champion, and track performance against them after launch.

• Serve as the internal authority on the Professional Services vertical, providing product, marketing, analyst relations, and pre-sales teams with the industry grounding they need to position, demonstrate, and sell effectively.

description:
ABOUT SPHINX

Sphinx builds software to solve complex national security problems in Space. Founded by engineers and technologists with deep experience across commercial and defense technology, we were frustrated by the outdated and insecure technology America's service members are forced to rely on. We're here to do better. 

We’re focused on building modern, scalable products with an emphasis on using open source technologies. Expect talented, motivated, and interesting colleagues who emphasize collaboration, transparency, and individual responsibility.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Sphinx is hiring a Corporate Security Manager (FSO/CSSO) to join our team and lead security operations in support of our growing portfolio of national security and space programs. This role will be responsible for maturing and overseeing all aspects of physical and personnel security Sphinx across all levels of classification. Our ideal colleague will ensure compliance with Department of Defense (DoD) and Intelligence Community (IC) requirements and applicable federal security regulations while enabling Sphinx to continuing 

This Corporate Security Manager (FSO/CSSO) will mature Sphinx’s Industrial and Program Security functions to keep pace of our growing classified portfolio and facility footprint. You will operate as both a FSO and a CSSO in support of programs at all levels of classification, and your work will require ensuring Sphinx is responsive to and compliant with multiple government organizations’ requirements, including SAP-specific security requirements. You’ll play a critical role in enabling our teams to execute sensitive defense missions.

What you will be focusing on:

• Lead day-to-day personnel and physical security operations for Sphinx facilities and programs; you’ll need to balance supporting specific programs and also maturing security processes, plans and posture of the entire company.

• Serve as the organization’s COMSEC Responsible Officer (CRO), overseeing COMSEC requirements in support of classified programs.

• Maintain compliance with applicable DoD, IC, contractual, and federal security requirements, including the implementation and management of both SCI and SAP security requirements.

• Oversee personnel security (PERSEC) activities, including clearance processing, access eligibility, briefings/debriefings, visit requests, and related security documentation.

• Interface with government security organizations and systems, particularly those supporting the Department of the Air Force, to ensure security requirements are blocking program activities.

• Support security inspections, audits, assessments, incident reporting, and corrective actions to maintain program and facility compliance.

• Develop, implement, and maintain security policies, procedures, training, and documentation appropriate for classified operations.

• Partner with program and company leadership to identify security risks and ensure security requirements are incorporated into program execution.

• Support the establishment, accreditation, and ongoing operation of new classified facilities as Sphinx continues to grow.

You might be a good fit if you:

• Have 10+ years of experience supporting security operations within the defense, intelligence, aerospace, or another highly regulated national security environment.

• Have experience serving as an FSO, CSSO, Program Security Officer/Representative, Personnel Security Lead, or in a comparable security leadership role.

• Are qualified or prepared to serve as a COMSEC Responsible Officer (CRO).

• Have strong knowledge of DoD and federal security requirements governing classified facilities, personnel, information, and programs.

• Have hands-on experience supporting SCI environments, with demonstrated knowledge of and experience supporting Special Access Program (SAP) security requirements and operations.

• Are experienced with government security and clearance systems such as NISS, JPAS, DISS, Scat

title: Customer Success Manager, Enterprise
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

Airwallex’s enterprise customer success team helps customers get more value from cross-border payments and financial operations. You’ll manage strategic customer relationships, solve operational challenges, and turn customer insight into business and product improvements.

- Drive growth for Airwallex’s cross-border payments business by managing enterprise customer relationships and uncovering scenario-based opportunities across cross-border finance.

- Build trusted partnerships with enterprise merchants by reviewing their day-to-day cross-border payment activity, understanding their operating status, and identifying ways to support continued growth.

- Resolve customer issues quickly and accurately across pricing configuration, KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and related payment operations.

- Bring customer insight to Product, Engineering, Risk, Compliance, and other teams by collecting, organising, and analysing market feedback, then turning it into practical recommendations.

- Use data analysis and optimisation expertise to help customers improve performance, while driving product, feature, and process improvements internally.

You'll work from our Shanghai office five days a week.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Essentials

- 3-5 years of experience in customer success, account management, payments, fintech, banking, or another relevant industry.

- Experience supporting enterprise or large-scale customers, with the ability to manage complex relationships and multiple stakeholders.

- Strong understanding of cross-border payments, financial operations, or related customer workflows.

- Ability to identify customer needs and pain points, develop practical solutions, and uncover opportunities for business growth.

- Strong data collection, analysis, and interpretation skills, with attention to detail and sensitivity to operational signals.

- Clear, confident communication skills across internal and external stakeholders.

- A proactive, results-driven approach, with strong logical thinking, resilience, and the ability to work effectively under pressure.

- Willingness to partner closely with Product, Engineering, Risk, Compliance, and other teams to improve customer outcomes.

Preferred

- Experience working with large enterprise merchants or multinational organisations.

- Experience handling pricing configuration, KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, or similar payment operations.

- Experience driving product, feature, or process optimisation based on customer and market insights.

YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

- You have experience at a fintech, payments company, or other highly regulated business.

- You stay close to your industry, follow trends, and bring outside perspective into your work.

- You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

- You communicate clearly and directly across cultures, and you're thoughtful about how context shifts meaning across borders.

title: Business Development Representative (BDR)

Join beqom - where Tech meets Impact
beqom is a high-growth B2B SaaS company that provides industry-leading tools for pay equity and transparency, compensation, and performance management. Trusted by some of the world’s most respected companies, beqom enables HR and business leaders to navigate global compliance and make smarter pay decisions that attract, retain, and motivate top talent.
Founded in Switzerland and serving clients worldwide, our powerful, enterprise-ready products are fueled by beqom pay intelligence.
The role
As a BDR, you’re the engine of our US pipeline. Every conversation you start with a Head of Reward, CHRO, or VP Total Rewards moves a deal closer to revenue. That is the job, and it’s measurable from day one.
Concretely, you’ll:

• Run 50+ cold calls a day and build outbound sequences that actually get replies

• Engage senior HR and Finance leaders at companies between 1,000 and 50,000 employees

• Qualify inbound demand from marketing, events, and pay equity regulation triggers (EU Pay Transparency Directive, US state laws)

• Build pipeline alongside Account Executives working complex Fortune 500 deals

• Experiment. Test new sequences, new tools, new angles.

Every conversation you start moves us - and you - forward.
What are we looking for?
What you need to bring

• 1 to 3 years in a sales, BDR, SDR, or customer-facing role (SaaS or B2B tech preferred, internships count)

• Strong written English. Comfortable on the phone with senior leaders.

• Self-starter who treats their pipeline like a business, not a checklist

• Remote

• You’ve already played with AI tools (Claude, Clay, Apollo, n8n) and you have opinions about what works

• You write outbound copy that doesn’t sound like a template

• You have a side project, a newsletter, a Substack, a GitHub, a TikTok, something that shows you build things

• You know your way around HubSpot, Lemlist, Outreach, Nooks, Zoominfo or LinkedIn Sales Navigator

The stack you’ll use daily
HubSpot, Lemlist, Nooks (parallel dialer), LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Gong, Slack, Google Workspace. Plus the AI tools you want to test. We give you a budget for that.
Why join us?

• Real ownership. You won’t inherit a script and a list. You’ll co-build the US outbound motion with our team.

• Real exposure. You engage senior leaders at Fortune 500 companies from your first month. The conversations you build are the foundation of an enterprise sales career.

• Real impact. We sell pay compensation software. The work you do funds a fairer compensation system at scale.

We are looking for a strategic, execution-oriented Head of People Operations to build and lead People Operations delivery across our North American and LATAM markets - and to set the standard for what world-class HR operations looks like at scale.  

This is a leadership role with genuine scope. You will own the full employee lifecycle across the US, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, and beyond, building a distributed team and driving the infrastructure that allows our people engine to scale. Payroll integrity, benefits strategy, compliance across multiple regulatory environments, and the intelligent use of automation and AI are at the heart of what this role is about.  

At Flix, People Operations is not a support function - it is a business-critical capability with direct ownership, real accountability, and a seat at the table where decisions get made. This role will help define what that looks like for North America and LATAM.

About the Role

• Regional Leadership: Build, lead, and develop a high-performing People Operations team across the US, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, and other LATAM markets. You set direction, develop talent, and create a culture of ownership and accountability across distance.

• Payroll Ownership: Take full accountability for multi-country payroll operations across NA and LATAM - including US federal and state payroll compliance, Canadian payroll, and complex LATAM payroll environments. You ensure accuracy, timeliness, and auditability at every step, and you know how to build the vendor and internal infrastructure to support it.

• Benefits Strategy & Administration: Own benefits program strategy, design, and administration for the region - including US health, dental, vision, 401(k), COBRA, and leave programs, as well as country-specific benefits across LATAM. You partner with brokers, manage renewals, and benchmark regularly to ensure Flix remains competitive.

• People Operations Excellence: Drive end-to-end HR service delivery across the full employee lifecycle - onboarding, offboarding, employment changes, compliance, data integrity, and tier-1/tier-2 HR support. You own SLAs, escalation frameworks, and a culture of responsiveness and quality.

• Automation & AI-Driven Operations: Lead the intelligent use of automation and AI to transform People Operations in your region. This means identifying repetitive, high-volume processes ripe for automation, evaluating and deploying HRIS/HRMS tooling, championing AI-assisted workflows, and building operational leverage that lets the team scale without headcount scaling linearly. You do not need to be an engineer - but you need to be genuinely curious and capable of driving this agenda.

• Compliance & Risk Management: Ensure HR compliance across a complex, multi-jurisdiction environment - including federal and state employment law in the US, Canadian labor standards, and the regulatory environments of LATAM countries. You anticipate risk before it becomes a problem.

• HQ-to-Regional Bridge: Serve as the primary interface between Flix global HQ and NA/LATAM operations. You translate global HR strategy into local execution, and you surface regional nuance - legal, cultural, operational - before it lands badly. You represent the region in global forums and ensure local needs are reflected in central decisions.

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube https://www.youtube.com/carwow channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

Carwow is hiring an Account Management Team Lead to join our Get Your Car (New Market) Partner Success team, focused on car buying. This is a player-coach role with your time split roughly 50/50. Half of it goes on leading and coaching a team of 3 Account Managers, and half on managing your own portfolio of dealer groups. You'll report into the Franchise Account Management Manager and be measured on hitting revenue and retention targets across both your team and your own portfolio.

This role is based in our London office three days a week, with travel to dealer partners as needed.

Leading the team:

- Coach and develop a team of 3 Account Managers through daily coaching, weekly 1-1s, call shadowing and regular feedback, helping each of them hit their targets and grow in their careers.

- Support your team with their day-to-day activity. Help them prioritise, prepare for key dealer conversations and work through challenges as they come up.

- Take ownership of your team's revenue and retention performance. Spot risks early and step in where accounts need support.

- Act as the first escalation point for your team on complex dealer challenges, commercial conversations and at-risk accounts.

- Help onboard new Account Managers so they quickly become confident experts on our product and their brands.

Managing your own portfolio:

- Own a portfolio of dealer groups, becoming an expert on their brands, challenges, opportunities and performance on the Carwow platform.

- Build strong, long-lasting relationships through proactive communication by phone and video, and get on the road to visit dealers in person when needed.

- Turn performance data into compelling presentations and a clear story that shows dealers the value of Carwow and brings them on the Carwow journey.

- Drive revenue and retention in your portfolio, including upselling additional products and services.

Managing your own portfolio:

- Find and build more efficient ways of working across the team, including smarter use of data, automation and AI tools.

- Work closely with our Marketplace, OEM and Partner Operations teams, and our field-based Account Management team, so that partner strategies are executed seamlessly.

- Share insight from your team's dealer conversations to help shape our marketplace, product and commercial decisions.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Essential

- Experience working in a marketplace business and a strong understanding of how two-sided marketplaces work, including supply, demand and the levers that drive partner performance.

- Strong data skills. You're comfortable analysing performance in Excel or Google Sheets and using it to coach your team and guide partner conversations.

- The ability to build clear, persuasive slide decks and tell a compelling, data-led story to dealer partners.
